fiveWhy.title: 🔍 5 Whys method
fiveWhy.description: Ask "why" repeatedly to find the root cause. For example:

steps.s1: Why did the accident happen? → The person fell from a ladder
steps.s2: Why did the person fall? → The ladder was unstable
steps.s3: Why was the ladder unstable? → The floor was slippery/uneven
steps.s4: Why was the floor slippery? → No risk assessment was performed
steps.s5: Root cause: Inadequate planning and risk assessment

placeholders.rootCause: Structure as five whys (Q&A), then a root-cause conclusion — or use the AI button for a draft.
placeholders.contributingFactors: Other factors that contributed to the event (e.g. time pressure, lack of training, poor communication)

hints.rootCause: Describe the root cause, not only the symptom

aiSuggest.helper: Drafts five “why” questions with possible answers and a root-cause conclusion.
